Blackstone has made a total of 235 acquisitions. It has expanded across 123 sectors, including REITs, Hotels, and IT Services, with a footprint spanning 25 countries, led by activity in United States, United Kingdom, and India. Peak acquisition years were 2021 with 32 deals, 2019 with 20 deals, and 2017 with 19 deals. From 2020 to 2025, the firm averaged 18 acquisitions per year, and it has completed 7 acquisitions so far this year. The most recent acquisition, completed in September 2026, is Fchinc, a Cincinnati-based manufacturer of sanitary flow components for the food, beverage, and pharmaceutical industries.
